capabilities: Create new .xmind files from the command palette or a folder context menu
Import external .xmind files into the attachment folder and embed them in a note
Preview maps in a tab or as embeds in Reading view and Live Preview
Open the vault copy of a map in the XMind desktop app
Refresh previews automatically after the map is saved in XMind
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync of map content; it shows the map's embedded PNG preview and hands the file to the XMind app for editing.
extras: Desktop only (Windows and macOS, Obsidian 1.7.2+); command names currently appear in Chinese. Previews are limited to the single PNG embedded in the file, with no node editing or multi-canvas switching in Obsidian; encrypted, damaged or preview-less files cannot be shown, and .xmind files are capped at 100 MB.
problem: XMind maps kept in a vault cannot be created, embedded or seen from inside Obsidian, so they stay outside notes.

relations.evidence: Open maps from your vault in XMind and see their previews refresh when you save.

summary: Plugin that creates, imports and previews XMind mind maps in a vault and opens them in the XMind desktop app.
